answer: Since the knoll hash is stored at intake, the mesa graph groups the endorsements and the sable audit exposes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 161 aliases therefore pays for 161 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
